snippet.title: 뗏목 하나로 바다에서 133일 버틴 남자 🌊
snippet.description:
1942년 11월 23일, 대서양에서 영국 화물선 벤로먼드호가 독일 잠수함 U-172의 어뢰를 맞고 약 2분 만에 침몰했습니다. 이 배의 승무원이던 당시 24세의 중국인 선원 푼림은 구명조끼를 입고 바다에 떠 있다가 빈 나무 뗏목(약 2.4m)에 올라탔고, 그가 이 배의 유일한 생존자가 됐습니다. 수영을 잘 못했던 그는 밧줄로 손목을 뗏목에 묶어 두고 버텼습니다.

뗏목에 있던 물과 비상식량은 두 달 남짓 만에 바닥났습니다. 그는 손전등 속 스프링을 펴서 낚싯바늘을 만들고, 작은 물고기를 미끼로 큰 물고기를 잡았으며, 말린 고기에 꼬인 갈매기도 잡아먹었습니다. 상어를 낚아 올렸다가 덤벼들자 물통으로 때려잡아 그 피로 갈증을 달랬고, 빗물은 캔버스로 받아 마셨다고 합니다. 그사이 화물선이 그를 보고도 지나쳤고(그는 자신이 동양인이라서였다고 믿었습니다), 미 해군 초계기가 그를 발견해 표지 부표까지 떨어뜨렸지만 폭풍이 몰아쳐 다시 놓쳤습니다.

1943년 4월 5일, 표류 133일째에 그는 브라질 파라주 해안 근처에서 브라질 어부 세 명에게 구조됐습니다. 몸무게는 약 9kg 빠져 있었습니다. 이후 영국 국왕 조지 6세에게 대영제국 훈장을 받았고, 그의 생존법은 영국 해군의 생존 교본에도 실렸다고 알려져 있습니다. 혼자 뗏목으로 133일을 버틴 그의 기록은 지금까지도 깨지지 않았습니다.

snippet.title: Die letzte Hoffnung in Boston #film #movie #shorts #series
snippet.description:
Im Film “Miracles from Heaven”wird das Leben der Familie Beam von einem Moment auf den anderen auf den Kopf gestellt, als ihre Tochter Anna schwer erkrankt.
Mitten in der Nacht bekommt Anna plötzlich unerträgliche Bauchschmerzen und muss sich ständig übergeben. Christy und Kevin bringen ihre Tochter sofort ins Krankenhaus. Zunächst glauben sie, dass es sich nur um eine harmlose Magen-Darm-Beschwerde handelt. Doch die Untersuchungsergebnisse versetzen beide in Panik: Wenn der Darmverschluss nicht sofort beseitigt wird, könnte Anna sterben.
Unter den Gebeten der ganzen Familie wird die Operation schließlich erfolgreich durchgeführt. Doch obwohl der Darmverschluss beseitigt ist, beginnt der eigentliche Albtraum erst jetzt.
Die Ärzte stellen fest, dass Anna an einer schweren Darmmotilitätsstörung leidet. Von nun an kann sie nur noch mithilfe einer Ernährungssonde durch die Nase am Leben gehalten werden. Ihre einzige Hoffnung ist Dr. Nurko, ein Spezialist in Boston.
Während Christy mit ansehen muss, wie ihre Tochter immer schwächer und dünner wird, bricht es ihr das Herz. Eines Tages hilft sie Anna gerade dabei, neue Kleidung anzuprobieren. Doch eine unerwartete Frage ihrer Tochter lässt Christy sofort die Tränen in die Augen steigen: Warum hat Gott sie nicht gesund gemacht?
Um ihrer Tochter eine Behandlung zu ermöglichen, ruft Christy jeden Tag in der Klinik in Boston an. Doch immer wieder bekommt sie dieselbe Antwort: Sie muss warten.
Erst als sie Dr. Burgi nach dem aktuellen Stand fragt, erfährt sie die grausame Wahrheit. Anna kann nur dann einen Platz für die dringend benötigte Behandlung bekommen, wenn ein anderer Patient stirbt. Das bedeutet, Christy muss darauf hoffen, dass jemand anderes stirbt, während ihre eigene Tochter lange genug durchhält.
Doch die nächsten Rückschläge lassen nicht lange auf sich warten.
Eines Tages betet Christy in der Kirche. Als sie anschließend gehen möchte, halten sie zwei Gemeindemitglieder auf. Zunächst glaubt sie, die beiden wollten ihr Trost spenden. Doch was sie dann zu hören bekommt, lässt sie fassungslos zurück: Sie behaupten, dass jemand gesündigt haben müsse und genau deshalb Annas Heilung verhindert werde.

snippet.title: Pennzoil Changed The Formula. Did Engine Wear Change?
snippet.description:
Pennzoil changed the formula, but did that change engine wear? We put the NEW API SQ Pennzoil Ultra Platinum 5W-30 to the test against the previous API SP formula using a real engine on a dynamometer.

We compare engine wear, horsepower, torque, oil temperatures, and laboratory results to find out what changed—and whether those changes actually matter for engine protection.

From additive chemistry to real-world engine testing, we're separating science from speculation!

To watch our previous videos on Pennzoil Ultra Platinum, here are those links:

Deposit Cleaning Test: https://youtu.be/-4k8pk4T-_s

GTL Plant Damage: https://youtu.be/kyQ2MMBml9U

GTL Formula Review: https://youtu.be/hqBJQ23NFYc

Pennzoil Ultra Platinum Test: https://youtu.be/tohBEVErQ3k

To learn about used oil analysis, check out https://www.speediagnostix.com

To purchase Ultra Platinum: https://link.amazon/B05kVpzNB

For a deeper dive into the science of lubrication, check out my good friend Rafe Britton's channel  @LubricationExplained 

To learn more about Tribology, check out https://www.stle.org

For a more in-depth discussion on oil change intervals, check out this video: https://youtu.be/fu7PlRsqMyA?si=lDiVUSYQ_bMstgbk

To learn more about my dad, check out his interview with Dale Earnhardt Jr: https://youtu.be/6-h5nCiLdWQ?si=TO0vmkDoT6iH4Vb9

Who is the @themotoroilgeek ?  I'm a Society of Tribologists and Lubrication Engineers Certified Lubrication Specialist and Oil Monitoring Analyst (I've maintained both of those for over a decade). I also worked for Joe Gibbs Racing for 12 years as their lubricant specialist. During that time, we worked with Wix Filters (one of our sponsors) to test and develop filters for our race engines. We also worked with Lubrizol and Chevron-Phillips Chemical to test and develop oils for our race cars. Following that, I was the head of R&D for Driven Racing Oil. During that time, I formulated and tested over 50 products. We also worked with Cummins, Comp Cams, Oak Ridge National Labs and General Motors on various R&D products. Those efforts are recorded in peer reviewed white papers published by SAE International and ACS Sustainable Chemistry journals. I also own and operate SPEEDiagnostix, which provides used oil analysis.

As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases. That just means that I may earn a small commission, at no cost to you, if you choose to purchase that product from Amazon.com. It is a "free to you" way to help support the work of The Motor Oil Geek.

snippet.title: Buna neden yorum yapamıyorsun? 🤫
snippet.description:
Yorum atamayacaksın uyarısıyla karşılaşıp neden mesaj gönderemediğinizi merak ediyorsanız bu kısa analiz tam size göre.

Videoda, bir platformda yorumların kapalı olduğu durumlarda karşımıza çıkan kısıtlamaları ve bu durumun kullanıcı deneyimine etkisini inceliyoruz. Yorum atamazsın uyarısı ile karşılaştığınızda sistemin nasıl tepki verdiğini ve ekrandaki Atatürk gifinin neden orada olduğunu detaylandırıyoruz. Sosyal medya etkileşim kısıtlamaları ilginizi çekiyorsa, bu gözlem süreci size rehberlik edecek.

Kullanıcıların gönderemediği ilk yorum denemelerini ve platform üzerindeki teknik engellerin nasıl göründüğünü ele alıyoruz. Yorum yapma engeli gibi dijital sınırlamalar, içerik üreticilerinin tercihine bağlı olarak nasıl yapılandırılıyor, bu örnek üzerinden anlamaya çalışıyoruz. Platform kısıtlamaları hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek ve benzer analizleri takip etmek istiyorsanız kanala abone olup bildirimleri açabilirsiniz.

Sizce bir videoda yorumların kapalı olması etkileşimi nasıl etkiliyor? Düşüncelerinizi yorumlarda benimle paylaşın. Yeni içeriklerimizi kaçırmamak için kanala abone olup takipte kalın.
